places.name: Charminar
places.description: Hyderabad's most iconic monument and the gateway to its greatest street bazaar.
places.bestTime: Early morning or 1 hour before sunset

places.name: Golconda Fort
places.description: One of the most formidable and historically significant forts in India, with a world-class sound-and-light show at night.
places.bestTime: Early morning or evening for the sound-and-light show

places.name: Qutb Shahi Tombs
places.description: A serene and architecturally extraordinary necropolis that most visitors to Golconda miss entirely.

places.name: Salar Jung Museum
places.description: One of the most eclectic and astonishing art collections in Asia, housed under a single roof.

places.name: Hussain Sagar Lake
places.description: The city's great communal waterfront, with the iconic Buddha statue at its heart.

places.name: Chowmahalla Palace
places.description: The most opulent Nizami palace open to the public, dripping with royal grandeur.

places.name: Falaknuma Palace
places.description: The most spectacular palace in Hyderabad, with views that justify the climb.

places.name: Laad Bazaar (Choodi Bazaar)
places.description: The most immersive and aromatic bazaar in Hyderabad — a complete sensory experience.

places.name: Mecca Masjid
places.description: A magnificent and historically resonant mosque — one of the great Mughal-era mosques of the Deccan.

places.name: Birla Mandir Hyderabad
places.description: The most visually striking temple in Hyderabad, with the best city panorama from the hillside.
places.bestTime: Evening for marble illumination and sunset views

budget.label: Budget
budget.blurb: Hostels or guesthouses, local food, public transport

midRange.label: Mid-range
midRange.blurb: Three-star hotels, a mix of restaurants, the odd taxi

comfortable.label: Comfortable
comfortable.blurb: Good four-star stays, restaurants by choice, tours
